meta.notes: Core metric. Null means the OpenWeather response was malformed or incomplete.
WHO hazardous ceiling is ~250 µg/m³. Kathmandu peaks around 300-400 in winter. 1000 is a data-sanity bound, not a health threshold. If we ever see >1000 it means sensor or API error.
No timestamp means we cannot partition or deduplicate. This row is useless.
City is the primary dimension for all KPIs.
Guard against typos or new cities being accidentally added to CITIES dict without updating downstream models.
OpenWeather's own AQI scale is 1-5 only. Values outside this range indicate a parsing bug.

We validate the current run's observed_at timestamps (up to 2 hours). Expect 4 cities × 1-2 hours = 4-8 rows. Min of 1 (not 4) because partial city failures are logged but allowed by fetch_all_cities. If all 4 cities fail, fetch_and_store_s3 raises before we reach validation.
Validates the last 2 hours of bronze.air_quality_raw. The query scope is set in the validate_bronze Airflow task, not here.
